features_tested: 🍔 Whataburger® Honey Butter Chicken Concourse Voucher
tester_feedback.favorite_feature: Immediate in-concourse redemption of Whataburger perks triggered right when our section hit 88 CMI.
tester_feedback.improvement_feedback: Add an optional audio chime or stadium organ ripple when the sponsor perk unlocks on Screen 3.

tester_feedback.favorite_feature: Seamless transition from tailgate chant preparation to in-stadium clutch defense that unlocks free food vouchers.
tester_feedback.improvement_feedback: Ensure concourse concession cashiers have handheld 2D scanners ready for the 18-char claim hashes.

tester_feedback.favorite_feature: Feeling like my individual energy directly contributed to unlocking a team-wide Dunkin' iced coffee voucher.
tester_feedback.improvement_feedback: Keep the rookie walkthrough tips visible in a small collapsible drawer while tapping during live plays.

features_tested: 🥩 H-E-B® True Texas Gameday Snack Voucher
📈 Two-Sided Commercial Unit Economics ($4.85 partner fee)
tester_feedback.favorite_feature: The mathematical transparency of the 4-factor formula (35/25/20/20) and tamper-evident SHA-256 integrity hash.
tester_feedback.improvement_feedback: Show the raw decibel delta curve side-by-side with the heart rate telemetry in the StoryCard.

tester_feedback.favorite_feature: Armchair coach callouts rallying row members to coordinate vocal surges during opponent free throws.
tester_feedback.improvement_feedback: Allow chant leaders to broadcast a 5-second countdown to coordinate Section 114 burst taps.

features_tested: 🍦 Culver's® Big House Custard Perk Voucher

tester_feedback.favorite_feature: One-click sharing of the verified Living Trophy Case with embedded cryptographic proof of attendance to Instagram Stories.
tester_feedback.improvement_feedback: Provide pre-formatted vertical 9:16 aspect ratio video cards for TikTok and Reels sharing.
